title: Which Halloween Candy Matches Your Personality?
description: Answer 12 sweet questions to find out which Halloween candy matches your personality — dark chocolate, candy corn, gummy worms, full-size bar and more!

questions.text: It's 8 p.m. on Halloween. Your candy situation is…

options.text: One premium dark bar, rationed for maximum impact
A chaotic open bowl, everyone grab whatever
Sorted by type in labeled containers, obviously
A mystery bag of candies from three countries

questions.text: A kid inspects your bowl with suspicion. You…

options.text: Let the data speak — try one yourself first
Give them two and tell them they deserve it
Point out the trusted name-brand options clearly
Challenge them to pick the weirdest one there
Skip the small talk, optimize the route
Compliment every decoration on the block
Hit the same trusted streets every single year
Follow the rumor of a house giving full-size bars

questions.text: The candy bowl has one piece left. You…

options.text: Weigh who deserves it by contribution to the night
Give it to the coldest-looking kid, no hesitation
Split it evenly. Fairness is non-negotiable.
Rock-paper-scissors, loser buys hot cocoa
A long solo walk with my own stash and headphones
A huge chaotic group in matching costumes
The same crew I've trick-or-treated with for years
Whoever I just met in the graveyard, honestly

questions.text: How do you feel about candy corn?

options.text: Empirically overrated. The data is clear.
It's nostalgic joy in kernel form and I'll defend it
It belongs in October's official inventory, yearly
I'd rather eat something that glows

questions.text: At the Halloween party snack table, you…

options.text: Graze quietly while having one good conversation
Orchestrate a candy-swap marketplace with everyone
Critique the chocolate-to-everything ratio
Make sure the shy guest gets first pick
Matte black with no marketing at all
Bright, loud, and fun to wave around
The classic design unchanged since the '80s
Handwritten. With a doodle.

questions.text: Someone eats your reserved Halloween candy. You…

options.text: Say nothing. Retire to the library. Remember forever.
Laugh, announce the theft theatrically, demand a rematch
Present receipts — I literally labeled and dated it
Forgive them instantly and check they're okay
The traditional ones: caramel, apple, nutmeg
Whatever unholy limited-edition fusion dropped today
A balanced spread with nothing too experimental
Three flavors in one item, consequences be damned
Exactly on schedule, teeth brushed, stash inventoried
With an unplanned adventure at 1 a.m.
When the plan says it ends
When the candy runs out, whenever that is

questions.text: You're picking one candy for a road trip with strangers. You pick…

options.text: Mints. Reliable. Quiet. Socially responsible.
A giant lollipop that becomes a conversation piece
The nut bar with the cleanest ingredient list
Sour straws and dare everyone to make the face

results.title: Dark Chocolate Square
results.description: Intense, sophisticated, and not for everyone — and you like it that way. You're the 72% cacao of people: deep, a little mysterious, and appreciated most by people with refined taste. Sweetness is optional.

results.title: Fizzy Sour Powder
results.description: You're an acquired, experimental delight — the candy nobody expects and nobody forgets. Curious and a little contrarian, you'd rather be fascinating than universally liked. Your flavor profile comes with its own warning label.

results.title: The Full-Size Bar
results.description: You show up premium. Generous on your own terms, ambitious, and impossible to overlook, you're the full-size bar in a pillowcase of fun sizes — the household that gives you out wins Halloween outright.

results.title: Popping Candy
results.description: Electric, unpredictable, and impossible to eat quietly, you're pure popping candy — you turn ordinary moments into events, spark ten ideas a minute, and leave every room crackling with energy.

results.title: Candy Apple
results.description: Bittersweet, glossy, and layered, you take a second bite to fully understand. There's a sharp, thoughtful core beneath your sweet exterior, and the people who take the time to know you become lifelong fans.

results.title: Homemade Cookie
results.description: Soft, rare, and made with actual love, you don't mass-produce yourself. Sincere and imaginative, you're the treat somebody stayed up baking — worth more than a whole bucket of anything wrapped in plastic.

results.title: Caramel Apple Pop
results.description: Warm, sweet, and built for sharing, you're the flavor of being looked after. Social and encouraging, you gather people close, keep spirits high, and make even a cold October night feel like home.

results.title: Gummy Worms
results.description: Playful, wiggly, and delighted by everything, you're here strictly for a good time. You make friends in seconds, turn snack bowls into adventures, and prove that joy doesn't need to make sense.

results.title: The Peppermint Classic
results.description: Reliable, crisp, and exactly what you promise, you never let anyone down. Traditional with high standards, you're the candy that always stays in stock — because some things are classics for a reason.

results.title: Candy Corn
results.description: Nostalgic, divisive, and completely at peace with it, you're a Halloween tradition. Gentle and loyal, you show up every single October exactly as you are — and the people who love you really, really love you.

results.title: Chocolate Coin
results.description: Solid, valuable, and wrapped in gold, you're the treat that feels like a small business decision. Organized and dependable, you're traded, saved, and respected — the reserve currency of the candy bag.

results.title: Ring Pop
results.description: Social, sparkly, and made to be shown off, you're friendship you can wear. Generous with attention and endlessly enthusiastic, you turn every interaction into a tiny celebration and remember every name in the room.

results.title: The Jawbreaker
results.description: Hard shell, long game, zero instant gratification. You're quiet, patient, and surprisingly layered — people who rush you get nowhere, but anyone willing to invest hours discovers the sweet center was worth the wait.

results.title: The Chocolate Rose
results.description: Beautiful, crafted, and almost too pretty to eat, you approach life like an artist. Understated and expressive, you care about how things look and feel — and your elegance makes people save you for last.

results.title: Sour Patch Kid
results.description: First you're chaos, then you're sweet — and everyone's addicted. Bold, fast-talking, and thrill-seeking, you keep people off-balance in the best way, disarming them with charm seconds after the trouble starts.

results.title: The Fun Dip Party
results.description: Pure sugar, pure joy, dipped straight into the good times. Loud, colorful, and made for groups, you're the energy source of every Halloween party — messy, ecstatic, and absolutely the most fun in the bag.

share_hook: Ask six friends this question and you'll get six different candies and six arguments. Which Halloween treat actually matches your personality?
